says: In a sev0 the freeze cancels push runs on main unless main is on the allow list, so main's own checks stop and a red main goes unseen.
proof: Freeze.ts line 37 says a push run on main is canceled too, and verdict keeps only merge_group runs and allowed branches. On 2026-11-18 main's check runs at f3d9d8f60, 65edf5c27 and 4909b55df show completed/cancelled, while main's lint was red: 1517 left scripts/typecheck.sh on NOT_YET_PORTED after 1506 deleted it. It surfaced only when pull requests merging main turned red, and was fixed by 1630.
cost: Every pull request that merges main inherits a red it did not cause, and the lead spends a round trip per pull request finding it. A sev0 is exactly when main changes fastest, so main's own checks matter most then.
